caption_lines.text: Why is there a Spanish club for socialists? Swipe for our story.

We started in July 2025, when organizers in DC doing food distribution, legal aid and tenant organizing wanted a place to practice their Spanish. Then the immigration crackdown hit DC, and it mattered even more.
On Saturday: what a Spanish Club actually looks like.
Free and open to all levels. RSVP at the link in bio.

items.what: About the club: how it works

caption_lines.text: Never been to Spanish Club? Here's what actually happens.

It's free and everyone's welcome. An hour and a half of Spanish practice in three levels (beginner, intermediate and advanced), mostly in small groups, with one-on-one "speed dating" for beginners and sometimes games.
Just starting out? Join our Discord for learning resources.
RSVP and Discord: link in bio. ¡Nos vemos!
